data: Does the model with auxiliary EOS loss predict longer sentences than the original model?

The caption states that the model trained with the auxiliary EOS loss can predict longer sentences compared with the original model. The graph shows two lines representing the average length difference results for the original model and the model with auxiliary EOS loss. The green line (WMT17 EN-DE Transformer W/Aux EOS loss) is consistently above the orange line (WMT17 EN-DE Transformer) across all k-step look-ahead values. This indicates that the model with auxiliary EOS loss predicts longer sentences than the original model. Therefore, the answer is yes.
